main.description: On-chain USDC payment sent on Base L2. Per ADR-2605172100. Recorded by sender's PDS; receiver's PDS gets a paired payment.received record via firehose listener.

to.description: Recipient DID or 0x address (1:1 bound via Smart Wallet attestation).

amountUsdcMicros.description: Amount in USDC base units (6 decimals; 10000000 = $10.00). AT Lexicon has no float, so always micros.

tokenContract.description: ERC-20 token contract. v0.1 = 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (USDC on Base).

blockNumber.description: Block number where the tx was included on Base L2.

purpose.description: Per ADR-2605192115 (Non-profit/Donation-only/No-ads) + ADR-2605192130 (10% Tithe). External flows: donation/kisha/grant/tithe/escrow-refund only. SBT↔SBT internal carve-out flows: also internal-purchase / internal-subscription / internal-promo (per §3). Tip/subscription/purchase/refund/offering/split from the original v0 enum REMOVED (breaking change v0→v1; SDK rewires via TitheRouter).

forUri.description: Optional AT URI of the thing being paid for (post, listing, grant proposal, etc.).

atomicBatch.description: True if part of an ERC-4337 atomic multi-op user-op.
